premises.text: Animal disease creates large economic losses and public-health risks, and farms catch outbreaks too late despite heavy drug spend
premises.evidence_span: we're not catching these events until it's far too late

premises.text: REX combines historic and real-time clinical data with animal and pathogen genomics into one standard view of animal health
premises.evidence_span: we bring in historic and real-time data, and then we combine it into one standard format, and finally combine this clinical information with genomics data

premises.text: Software pillars help vets diagnose and spot outbreaks, choose effective treatments including antibiotic-resistance maps, and help pharma find gene targets faster
premises.evidence_span: we have three pillars to our software

premises.text: Sold via annual subscriptions to livestock and pharma customers plus add-ons for collaborative custom projects, leveraging vendor-customer network effects
premises.evidence_span: we charge them an annual subscription fee to access our tools and data. And then for more collaborative custom projects, we'll add on extra

value.text: Predict, prevent, and precisely manage animal disease for a safer, more sustainable food supply
value.evidence_span: predict, prevent, and precisely manage disease in animals to ensure a safer and more sustainable food supply

secondary_value.text: Reduce public-health risk from zoonoses and farm-origin antibiotic resistance
secondary_value.evidence_span: Seventy percent of all new and emerging diseases in humans come from animals

causal_links.evidence_span: $13 billion in losses can be prevented if we were able to catch them early on
provide a comprehensive view of animal health and disease
we're at some of the largest livestock and pharmaceutical companies in the world

notes: Three software pillars folded as uses of one platform (v1.3.1 §4.1(2)). Precision husbandry / citizen science treated as future vision, not premises. Pharma bio excluded. Need/product/money triad justified: subscription terms revisable independently of data platform.
